title: Bitcoin AI Model Review — Week 48: 3 of 6 Calls Correct
meta_description: Week 48 graded: 3 of 6 Bitcoin calls correct (50%). All-time: 38.5% over 104 public calls. Paper portfolio +10.2% vs holding.

intro: Welcome to the QuantAura Signals weekly recap for the period from 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-21.
This week the model achieved 3 hits out of 6 resolved calls, resulting in a week accuracy of 50.0 percent.
That leaves performance right at a coin flip after six consecutive sell signals.
days: The model opened the week with two sell calls on Monday and Tuesday at confidence levels of 88.6 percent and 83.8 percent.
Both calls graded false as bitcoin fell by only 0.38 percent on Monday and 0.64 percent on Tuesday.
The momentum picked up over the next three days with sell signals calling for larger downside.
Bitcoin dropped by 1.71 percent on Wednesday, 2.8 percent on Thursday, and 5.15 percent on Friday.
The model scored three consecutive hits across those days with confidence ratings of 91.9 percent, 90.8 percent, and 94.4 percent.
spotlight: The spotlight call of the week took place on Saturday, 2026-11-21.
The model issued a sell signal with its highest confidence of the week at 97.7 percent.
Instead of dropping, bitcoin moved up by 1.91 percent, making the call entirely wrong.
That bad prediction graded as a miss, bringing the week total to 3 misses.
trend: Bitcoin experienced a deep selloff in the middle of the tracking period before rebounding on Saturday.
The persistent sell signals aligned with the strong down moves from Wednesday through Friday.
However, the model failed to capture the flat early days and the weekend price reversal.
portfolio: The paper portfolio started with 10000.0 dollars and stands at 11014.61 dollars after 105 days and 10 trades.
That yields a total return of 10.15 percent compared to a buy and hold return of minus 6.98 percent.
The buy and hold strategy ended at a value of 9302.09 dollars, meaning the signals beat holding by 17.13 percent.
Trading costs totalled 163.2 dollars at 0.15 percent per side, and the portfolio currently sits in cash.
record: The all time record now stands at 40 hits and 64 misses across 104 resolved calls.
That puts the overall accuracy at 38.5 percent, while the 30 day accuracy is 33.3 percent over 24 resolved calls.
The current week outperformed both of those longer baselines.
With only 104 total calls evaluated so far, the sample size remains small and requires ongoing tracking.

research.title: Why the model predicts regimes, not prices
paragraphs: The model does not predict prices. It classifies the next twenty four hours into an upward, downward, or flat regime.
Exact price targets are noise at this horizon. Regimes are the part of the problem a model can actually learn.
Ask a model for a number it cannot know and it will hand you one anyway. We would rather ask it a question it can answer.
